question: In 1956, Indonesia-born American cytogeneticist Joe Hin Tjio announced that the exact number of human chromosomes is _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**46**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joe Hin Tjio:-**

 
 
• He was an Indonesian-born American cytogeneticist who made significant contributions to the field of genetics, particularly in understanding the structure and number of human chromosomes.
 
• **Joe Hin Tjio announced that the exact number of human chromosomes is 46.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Human Chromosomes:-**

 
 
• Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes in each cell, for a total of 46 chromosomes.
 
• These chromosomes are organized into two main types:-
 
 
• **Autosomes**: The first 22 pairs of chromosomes are called autosomes. They are not involved in sex determination.
 
• **Sex chromosomes:** The 23rd pair of chromosomes is called the sex chromosomes. These chromosomes determine an individual's sex. Females typically have two X chromosomes (XX), while males typically have one X chromosome and one Y chromosome (XY).
